identifier_space_override: results_path uses Entrez Gene ID ('gene' column), not HGNC symbol, because direct inspection of the staged WikiPathways GMT showed its gene-set members are numeric Entrez Gene IDs despite the reference-store catalog description stating HGNC symbols. gmt_path points to a cleaned copy (output/refdata/wikipathways_clean.gmt) with a readable 'name (WPID)' pathway-name field; gene-set membership is untouched.
note: This file was reconstructed from the render tool's response immediately after rendering, because the tool always writes to the fixed path output/decision_record.json.
